competitor.name: NTRDB
competitor.rights: Explicit prohibition on scraping, mirroring, or systematically copying the database without permission. No bulk work records, user content, covers, ratings, or 982-tag taxonomy imported.

public_metrics.label: all-format works
public_metrics.interpretation: All formats, not a distinct count of adult animation or confirmed NTR-themed originals.

public_metrics.label: characters
public_metrics.interpretation: Displayed count, unique identity quality not independently assessed.

public_metrics.label: developers, studios and circles
public_metrics.interpretation: Provider's total across all media, not animation production contractors only.

public_metrics.label: work tags
public_metrics.interpretation: Six provider categories, no imported proprietary term list.

public_metrics.label: community lists
public_metrics.interpretation: Provider-displayed count of public user-created lists.

public_metrics.label: October 2026 calendar entries
public_metrics.interpretation: Mixed formats and release/update types, including upcoming; NOT original anime episodes.

public_metrics.label: works with store sale listings
public_metrics.interpretation: Marketplace-affiliate results, dynamic and not the total catalog.

tag_framework.interpretation: Research only: model distinct semantic axes, do not bulk copy lists or imply 982 tags individually verified.

capabilities.label: Multi-medium searchable index
capabilities.next: Increase independent canonical animated works; permit original-medium cards and cross-media edges.

capabilities.label: Animation-first series/episode model
capabilities.next: Full per-episode pages, staff, broadcast vs packaging and cross-edition lineage.

capabilities.label: Character, producer and staff directory
capabilities.next: Normalize role-specific producer, label, circle, director, artist and character edges.

capabilities.label: Advanced format, year, language, quality, subgenre, status filters
capabilities.next: Add full faceted filter and saved shareable URL state with zero required accounts.

capabilities.label: Multi-category semantic tags
capabilities.next: Expand curated owned vocabulary by distinct narrative, consent, perspective, content-note, tone, setting and technical axes.

capabilities.label: Reader blacklist of undesirable themes
capabilities.next: Implement session-only, client-side opt-out filters initially; persist only with consent.

capabilities.label: Spoiler-aware screenshots, hidden identities and tags
capabilities.next: Design spoiler-tiered facts with clear reveal controls before user accounts.

capabilities.label: Multi-format release calendar with updates and future
capabilities.next: A date-based mobile view with primary-vs-community evidence and updated/scheduled badges.

capabilities.label: Community ratings, weighted score, NTR intensity
capabilities.next: Define clear orthogonal metrics, confidence and anti-brigading controls, privacy and moderation.

capabilities.label: Personal recommendations and linked similar works
capabilities.next: Deterministic non-erotic relationship/credit matching first; avoid unsafe age-themed discovery.

capabilities.label: Community list, ranked, tier, grid views
capabilities.next: Private local lists first; moderation and authentication before public lists.

capabilities.label: Producer accounts and claimed records
capabilities.next: Require identity verification, edit history and explicit dispute rights.

capabilities.label: User suggestions with vote, status and moderator reasoning
capabilities.next: Publish governed contributor workflow after user accounts and moderation are ready.

capabilities.label: Achievements, coins, levels, cosmetic shop, mascot
capabilities.next: Reward evidence-backed edit quality, corrections and source confirmations instead of indiscriminate uploads.

capabilities.label: Multilingual titles and localized UI
capabilities.next: PT-BR / EN / Japanese title aliases first, no automatic translation of unverified facts.

capabilities.label: Official stores, creator links, sale aggregation
capabilities.next: Official legal storefront links only; no pirate mirrors, compliance and labeling of affiliate relationships.

capabilities.label: Developer updates and subscriptions
capabilities.next: Publisher announcement change log and optional RSS without requiring social profiles.

capabilities.label: Citation, certainty, corrected provenance at field level
capabilities.provider: work has some external links, full field audit not established
capabilities.next: Make per-field source chips and visible correction history the core differentiation.

capabilities.label: Performant, responsive app-like interface
capabilities.provider: reported slow by one journalist; no benchmark measurements
capabilities.next: Set objective web-vitals budgets and conduct real-device QA; don't claim competitor universally slow.

capabilities.label: Title aliases, original episode vs reissue vs formats
capabilities.provider: various alternate titles/editions, detailed validation not established
capabilities.next: Identity graph and manufacturer SKU-based merging/alias confidence.

capabilities.label: Pre-publication content moderation, DMCA, 18+ policy
capabilities.next: Review hosting rules, age assurance, takedowns and licensed-art ledger before public deployment.
